refreeze.note: re-frozen before any AP run: the first freeze's neighbour pair model (derivation 1) did not follow from its premise; it used the symmetric joint tilt with the neighbour's marginal reset to N(0, lambda), correlation rho. Corrected to the conditional tilt x' | x ~ N(rho x, lambda (1 - rho)), which fits the synthetic 200-NN pairs' per-input correlation 2-7 times better (rms error; see the module docstring, 'Re-freeze'); the mean-field law and the pair-model check were updated to match; nothing else changed.
